responsibility: Implements the reusable C-syntax pretty printer used by C-family front ends for trees, diagnostics, and dumps. It provides grammar-oriented printing of expressions, declarations, types, qualifiers, initializer forms, and C-specific statements such as FOR_STMT/WHILE_STMT/DO_STMT, manages token spacing and punctuation policy through c_pretty_printer, and exposes helpers to print complete trees for human-readable IR output.
same_name_distinction: Concrete pretty-printer implementation: unlike c-pretty-print.h, which declares the c_pretty_printer class interface and helper APIs, this file provides the actual C-syntax printing logic for expressions, declarations, statements, and full tree dumping.
